exposure: Onset of chronic pain (during pregnancy, after labor, or both)
cohort: 1,171 Swedish women who gave birth to a living child
finding: Eight months after giving birth, 16.7% of the women reported chronic pain related to childbirth, and 19.2% experienced dyspareunia.
mod_finding: Women reported a lower prevalence of chronic pain after vaginal delivery than cesarean section, but there was no difference in the prevalence of dyspareunia based on mode of delivery.
